scope: Consumed three-pair mechanism diagnosis and label-visible autonomous visual comparison, not independent confirmation
preprocessing_reconstruction: All three precorrection and learned parent PNG hashes exact

visual_review.reviewed: Three five-arm sheets and all three source-size NCC images, compared with parent images inspected in preceding development review

rows.observation: Snow: broad yellow/cyan mottling markedly reduced; darker stronger photograph, but mild green/magenta fringing and source noise remain. Improvement over full pipeline, not clear film-style advantage over simple control.
Fruit: unnatural bright orange/red and yellow with excessive chroma, particularly orange/apple/banana and blocks. Geometry and texture retained, appearance less balanced than simple control.
Daisies: strong emerald/teal shadows, near-fluorescent yellow centres and green foliage. Structure retained but less coherent than the parent's muted flower result; not preferred over simple.

descriptive_metrics_not_gates.caveat: Sampled continuous LUT derivatives omit uint8 rounding. Determinant sign did not track perceived severity. Pixel-boundary rates are post-result diagnostics, not retrospective gates.

interpretation: Covariance preprocessing materially contributes to this snow failure, while removing it alone leaves excessive learned chroma on other photos. This supports a preprocessing/model interaction, not a universal failure of VCG or AI. No seed/reference/step/strength sweep was used.
next: Preserve this learned baseline and stop this three-pair parameter family. Any successor needs a materially specified learned operator/supervision or stability mechanism and new independently frozen assessment; do not hand-design a palette or promote by tuning these pictures.
